articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ:MIGI) (“Mawson'' or the “Company”), a digital infrastructure provider, announces today that it has signed a lease amendment for its facility in Midland, PA which will allow for an additional 20 MW of power capacity. Upon completion of development works, the site will have 120 MW of capacity. The site is expected to be 100% online in early Q2, 2023.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc Expands Midland Facility to 120 MW
